items.label: HAMMERFIST! /FLT
items.why: The release intro leads to the original loading picture and its seven-selection music bank. The picture is rebuilt on graphics.html; every stored music selection is played on index.html. Intro/loader code serves only release startup and is outside the game analysis scope.

items.label: 1-HAMMERFIST
items.why: The original unpacker writes $0400-$29FF and $3200-$FFF9. All 62458 payload bytes match the live first-load hand-over; resident owns its shared routines and initialization.

items.label: 2-HAMMERFIST
items.why: The original unpacker writes $0800-$0FFF, $3200-$3202 and $348F-$FFF9. All 54126 payload bytes match the live second-load hand-over.

items.label: 3-HAMMERFIST
items.why: The original unpacker writes $0800-$0FFF, $3200-$3202 and $348F-$FFF9. All 54126 payload bytes match the live third-load hand-over.

items.label: 4-HAMMERFIST
items.why: The original unpacker writes $0800-$0FFF, $3200-$3202 and $339F-$FFF9, replacing the load trampoline as well. All 54366 payload bytes match the live fourth-load hand-over.

items.label: LD
items.why: Serial stream loader and unpacker entered at $2A00 for numbered replacements; its initial-load entry at $2A60 hands over at $2800.
